name: Cambridge-style B2 First (Writing)
description: Four criteria scored 0-5, modelled on the public structure of the B2 First writing assessment.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: All content is relevant and the target reader is fully informed; every point required by the task is covered.

criteria.name: Communicative Achievement
criteria.description: Uses the conventions of the task type (essay, email, review, article, report) appropriately to hold the reader's attention and communicate straightforward and some complex ideas; register suits the reader.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: Text is well organised and coherent, using a variety of cohesive devices and organisational patterns (paragraphing, linking words, referencing).

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: Uses a range of vocabulary, including less common lexis, and a range of simple and complex grammatical forms with control and flexibility; errors do not impede communication.
